openPanel.text: Closes the admin panel and opens w_hud's own panel (F7). It has the same settings plus the HUD look each player picks for themselves.

group.needs: How fast every player gets hungry and thirsty. Changes reach everyone at once, with no restart.
group.damage: What happens when a player gets very hungry or thirsty: health drops little by little, and they may die if you allow it.
group.features: Turning an element off hides it from every player's screen at once, and players cannot bring it back from their settings.
group.identity: The server name or logo shown in the corner of every player's screen, with its place and size.
group.player: Changes one player's hunger and thirst now, for example if they got stuck or starved because of a bug. Nobody else's settings change.

hungerRate.text: How much the hunger bar, out of 100, drops each cycle. Higher means hungrier faster; zero means never hungry.
hungerRate.example: 1 every 90 s takes a player from full to starving in about 2.5 hours

thirstRate.text: Same idea as hunger, for thirst. Higher means thirstier faster; zero means never thirsty.
thirstRate.example: 1.4 every 90 s leaves a player parched in about 1 hour 47 minutes

interval.text: Every how many seconds hunger and thirst drop. At least 5 seconds so the server stays light.
interval.example: 90 means once every minute and a half

damage.enabled: On: a player whose hunger or thirst is under the limit slowly loses health. Off: the bars are for show only.

hungerAt.text: When the hunger bar falls under this number, health starts dropping.
hungerAt.example: 15 means when less than 15 of 100 hunger is left

thirstAt.text: When the thirst bar falls under this number, health starts dropping.
thirstAt.example: 15 means when less than 15 of 100 thirst is left

amount.text: How much health each hit takes, as a share of the full health bar.
amount.example: 2 means two percent of health every hit

damage.interval: The seconds between two hits. A smaller number means hunger and thirst kill faster.
damage.canKill: Off: health drops to just above death and stops there, so nobody dies of hunger or thirst.

features.health: Shows or hides the health circle for every player.
features.stamina: Shows or hides the stamina circle for every player.
features.hunger: Shows or hides the food circle. Hiding it does not stop hunger itself.
features.thirst: Shows or hides the water circle. Hiding it does not stop thirst itself.
features.voice: Shows the player's voice range and when they talk.
features.horse: Shows the horse's health and stamina circles while the player rides.
features.buffs: Shows badges for the effects running now, like buffs and poison.
features.ammo: Shows how many rounds are in the weapon the player holds.
features.money: Shows the player's money on screen.
features.identity: Shows the character's name and ID on the HUD.
features.compass: Shows the compass at the top of the screen.
features.location: Shows the name of the place the player is in.
features.playerImages: Lets players add their own images to their HUD. Turning it off hides them for everyone.
features.playerPanel: Lets players change their HUD look and where things sit from the F7 panel. Turning it off fixes the staff layout for everyone.

identity.name: The server name shown in the corner of every player's screen. At most 48 characters.

logoUrl.text: The logo image link. With a link, the logo shows instead of the name for everyone. It must start with https or it is cleared on save.

identity.logoWidth: How wide the logo is on screen, from 2 to 160.
identity.logoHeight: How tall the logo is. Zero means it follows the width by itself.

x.text: Where the name or logo sits from the left, as a share of the screen width.
x.example: 98 means almost at the right edge

y.text: Where the name or logo sits from the top, as a share of the screen height.
y.example: 2 means near the top of the screen

identity.scale: The size of the name or logo. 1 is normal size, 2 is double.
identity.opacity: How solid the name or logo is. 1 is fully solid, 0.5 is half see-through.

target.text: The citizen ID of the player whose hunger and thirst you want to change. They must be in the game.

player.now: The player's hunger and thirst now, updated every 2 seconds.
player.hunger: The new hunger value out of 100. 100 means completely full, zero means starving.
player.thirst: The new thirst value out of 100. 100 means fully quenched, zero means parched.

applyHunger.text: Sets the player's hunger to the number you chose, now. They see the bar change at once.
applyHunger.undo: Yes, pick another number and apply

applyThirst.text: Sets the player's thirst to the number you chose, now. They see the bar change at once.
applyThirst.undo: Yes, pick another number and apply

player.refill: Fills the player's hunger and thirst to 100 in one go.

damage.hungerAt: Damage starts when hunger is under
damage.thirstAt: Damage starts when thirst is under

player.pick: Type the citizen ID of a player in the game to change their hunger and thirst.
player.noNeeds: This player has no hunger and thirst right now (maybe no character picked yet).
